validity_findings: All twelve V1-V8 validity gates PASS: V1_code_fidelity_manifest (harness sha256 matches frozen source_sha256 acbb1e1f...), V2_transport_conformance (stdlib HTTP on loopback), V3_no_leak (15/15 protocol invariants hold, chain task resource_id null in scored sessions, no answer leak), V4_determinism (two scored runs byte-identical), V5_arm_liveness (T=1.0 and PC=1.0 at all 8 family/novelty cells), V6_counter_instrumentation (all four counters with matched accounting), V7_matched_correctness (exact-match, matched_correctness==success_rate in all 56 cells), V8_ceiling_band (all arms 1.0 at novelty 0.0), V8_identity_disclosure (B-CROSS-SESSION-COMPILE success- and counter-identical to T), V8_mechanism_nondegenerate (100 instances: a_zero=0, duplicate_x=0, solve_fail=0, query_collision=0, min_query_gap=399759921), V8_mechanism_off (NC-MECHANISM-OFF drives within-session comparator to 1.0), V8_retention_counter_distinctness (T vs retention comparators: 2-3/4 dims distinct, >= MIN_DISTINCT_DIMS=2).
Harness fidelity verified: run_experiment.py sha256 equals frozen spec.design_satisfiability_probe.source_sha256; probe-mode and selftest-mode stdout reproduce frozen sha256 byte-for-byte.

No leakage detected: protocol_invariants.json confirms all 15 invariants hold; the chain task resource_id is null in scored sessions; the required answer M(x_q) and M(M(x_q)) appears in no scored session/task/error body; calibration labels appear only in their own calibration receipts.
Determinism verified: two independent scored matrix runs (56 cells x 20 sessions = 1120 bank instances each) produced byte-identical outcomes.
Arm liveness verified: T-MECHANISM-INHERIT and PC-EXACT-REPLAY achieve 1.0 success rate at every band (novelty 0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75) for both families.
Counter distinctness verified at novelty 0.5: B-WITHIN-SESSION-RECEIPT (2/4), B-WITHIN-SESSION-COMPOSE (2/4), B-RETRIEVAL-REPLAY (3/4), B-MEMORYLESS (2/4) — all meet MIN_DISTINCT_DIMS=2.
NC-MECHANISM-OFF sensitivity control verified: exposing the chain answer drives within-session retention comparator to 1.0 in both families, destroying the certificate as designed.
NC-MECHANISM-NONDEGENERATE verified: affine mechanism is genuine (a != 0, distinct calibration inputs, exact affine recovery, no query collision over 100 instances).

The retention ladder (no retention-only scope closes the range) is correctly treated as a declared control/predictor, NOT a validity gate — a closing scope is a scientific COLLAPSED/PARTIAL outcome, not MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
baseline_findings: The three retention comparators (B-WITHIN-SESSION-RECEIPT, B-WITHIN-SESSION-COMPOSE, B-RETRIEVAL-REPLAY) are correctly pinned at the information-theoretic (K-1)/K rate by construction: F1-RECORDS (K=8) = 0.875, F2-WIDGETS (K=10) = 0.900 at both scored bands (novelty 0.5 and 0.75). This matches the frozen retention_lattice_arithmetic closed-form prediction exactly.
B-MEMORYLESS baseline also achieves (K-1)/K at scored bands, as predicted (fresh session per task, no retention).
Treatment margins over all three retention comparators are 0.125 (F1) and 0.100 (F2) at both scored bands, exceeding MARGIN_FLOOR=0.05 by factors of 2.5x and 2.0x respectively.

All three retention comparators satisfy retention_certifies at all four scored cells (12/12): comparator_rate < COMPARATOR_MAX (0.95), all arm rates >= CORRECTNESS_FLOOR (0.80), matched_correctness >= 0.80, margin >= 0.05.

The identity control B-CROSS-SESSION-COMPILE is success- and counter-identical to T (margin 0) by construction, as disclosed. It is correctly excluded from retention_certifies (which requires positive margin) and does not count as a certificate comparator.

Counter accounting matches frozen per-instance predictions exactly (e.g., T F1: 34 http, 16 verification, 0 retrieval, 0 repair per instance; B-RETRIEVAL-REPLAY F1: 36 http, 8 retrieval, 16 verification, 1 repair per instance).
claim_ceiling: A hardened V3 credential-free bank (SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V3, Session-Mechanism-Inheritance class, affine mechanism M(x)=(a*x+b) mod P with P=2**40-87, K in {8,10}) is constructible and certified pre-freeze such that: (1) the treatment arm carrying a compiled mechanism across the session boundary achieves success_rate=1.0 at all scored bands; (2) all three retention-only comparators (within-session full-receipt log, within-session compose, cross-session raw-example replay) are pinned at the information-theoretic (K-1)/K rate (0.875 F1, 0.900 F2) with treatment margins of 0.125 and 0.100 respectively, exceeding MARGIN_FLOOR=0.05; (3) all twelve V1-V8 validity gates pass; (4) the separation is compile-vs-retain over identical raw information (scored session contains no labelled (x,M(x)) pair). This discharges readiness blocker B2 **for this specific substrate construction only**. The result does not promote any mechanism to Product Core, does not change C-MEAS-VALID status, and does not authorize the four-arm benchmark (which independently requires B1 and B3).
unresolved: Whether real external comparator arms (e.g., COLD / INSTRUCTIONS / RETRIEVAL in a future C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark) actually behave like within-session full-receipt memory; only synthetic comparator policies were measured here.
Whether the same memory-robust range holds for K outside {8,10} or for non-affine / non-SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V3 hidden mechanisms; only K in {8,10} and one affine family were measured.

Whether the flagship four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark can be run at all: B1 (audited parameterized carrier promoted into the kernel) and B3 (capable same-protocol agent endpoint) remain unresolved and gate it independently.
Whether the identity control B-CROSS-SESSION-COMPILE can be separated from T by a substrate change while preserving a credential-free discovery path; untested here.

The experiment's scope is bounded to a synthetic credential-free stdlib-only HTTP bank on 127.0.0.1 loopback; it does not measure a real external LLM/browser agent or any natural/economically-bearing Web task.
